verdict.rationale: Persona documents recurring Watchlist Reports against accounts (e.g., monthly or yearly), which covers re-screening of previously verified users on a schedule. Its webhooks can notify on events for any Persona resource, and workflows and Cases give ops a place to act. However, this is interval-based re-runs, not documented continuous screening triggered by watchlist list updates, and no evidence shows a specific event fired when a re-screen result changes. Missing for 10: continuous monitoring tied to watchlist updates rather than fixed intervals, explicit documentation of change or new-match events from recurring reports, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops lead, screening is not one-shot — previously verified users are continuously re-screened against watchlist updates, and changes raise events I can act on

citations.quote: Reports can be configured to run in regular intervals against an account. For example, you can run a Watchlist Report against your accounts each month or once a year.
Webhooks can notify your service about events that happen on any Persona resource.
Cases includes a configurable UI for the operations team
